annotations.title: Add a lead to a job

description: Stores a person who answered the employer's OWN form or advertisement (a lead ad, a landing page, an event list) beside one of the employer's jobs, before they apply. Find-or-create by job + email: a repeat updates the same lead and fills only what the new call states. Jobiba does not email or call the lead; send the invitation yourself with the job link in the answer. A lead becomes an applicant only by applying. Leads are deleted 180 days after they were added. Add only people who gave their details to this employer for hiring.

consent.description: What the person agreed to, as the employer recorded it, e.g. "Ticked: contact me about jobs, 18 Nov".

email.description: The lead's email address, as they gave it.

jobId.description: Jobiba job ID (the id field from search_jobs or list_my_jobs).

note.description: The employer's own note on the lead, up to 1,000 characters.

phone.description: The lead's phone number, if they gave one.

source.description: Where the lead came from, e.g. "Facebook lead ad, November".

name: add_lead
